nodes.title: SG-5.1 · One owner for round types, admin routes agree with them
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/round/round.go is now the only declaration of Status, Round and CanTransition, and go build ./... passes. But internal/admin.RoundService speaks world.Round while round.Service speaks round.Round, and server.New never mounts the admin round routes, so TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted fails with 404. Desired: the round, lifecycle and scheduler files agree on the same types and the backend serves them. Why: SG-5 lifecycle must be reachable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the backend tree, when go build ./... and go vet ./... run, then both succeed with Status, Round and CanTransition declared only in internal/round/round.go
- Given server.New with admin.token tok, when each admin round endpoint is called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404
- Given a round.Service error, when an admin round handler maps it, then ErrNotFound gives 404 and ErrIllegalTransition or ErrActiveRound gives 409


## Scope
- In scope: adapter from round.Service to admin.RoundService
- In scope: mount admin round routes in server.New
- In scope: start round.Scheduler
- Out of scope: frontend
- Out of scope: worker
- Out of scope: new round states
- Preserve: round.Round and Transitions table
- Preserve: existing execution admin routes
- Preserve: admin.Middleware token auth


## Technical constraints
- Go, chi, no database
- round package remains sole owner of Status, Round, CanTransition


## Definition of done
- go build ./... and go test ./internal/server ./internal/round ./internal/admin pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin round service adapts round.Service with consistent types and errors
nodes.body:
Context: admin.RoundService returns world.Round and uses admin.ErrNotFound/ErrConflict/ErrInvalid; round.Service returns round.Round and round.ErrNotFound/ErrIllegalTransition/ErrActiveRound. Desired: one adapter in internal/server converts round.Round to world.Round and maps errors. Expected: handlers return correct statuses.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a round.Round with status OPEN, when converted, then world.Round has the same ID, Number, StartsAt, EndsAt and Status string OPEN
- Given round.ErrNotFound, round.ErrIllegalTransition or round.ErrActiveRound, when the adapter returns it, then errors.Is matches admin.ErrNotFound, admin.ErrConflict, admin.ErrConflict respectively


## Scope
- In scope: internal/server/rounds_adapter.go
- Out of scope: changing admin handlers
- Preserve: admin.RoundService interface
- Preserve: world.Round JSON shape


## Technical constraints
- Do not redeclare round types


## Definition of done
- Adapter compiles and satisfies admin.RoundService


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin round routes mounted and scheduler started in the server
nodes.body:
Context: server.New mounts only execution routes under /api/v1/admin. Desired: also mount POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions using round.Service built from round.FileStore, gitCLI and contribution store; main starts round.Scheduler with cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given admin token tok, when each of the five round endpoints is requested with Bearer tok, then status is not 404
- Given no Authorization header, when a round endpoint is requested, then status is 401
- Given cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval, when the scheduler is built, then its Interval equals that value and Worlds lists world IDs from world.Repo


## Scope
- In scope: internal/server/server.go
- In scope: cmd/server/main.go
- Out of scope: frontend admin UI
- Preserve: execution routes
- Preserve: player and contribution routes


## Technical constraints
- Round files live under cfg.Storage.RepoPath


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Scheduler stops when the process context is cancelled


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Create roundAdmin adapter with type conversion and error mapping
nodes.description: Add internal/server/rounds_adapter.go with a roundAdmin struct wrapping *round.Service and the conversion round.Round -> world.Round, mapping round errors to admin errors.
acceptance_criteria: Errors map to admin sentinel errors via fmt.Errorf %w

steps.action: Create the package server file with func toWorldRound(r round.Round) world.Round copying ID, Number, string(Status), StartsAt, EndsAt, and func mapRoundErr(err error) error that wraps round.ErrNotFound as admin.ErrNotFound and round.ErrIllegalTransition and round.ErrActiveRound as admin.ErrConflict via fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ...), otherwise returns err unchanged.
steps.code: func mapRoundErr(err error) error { switch { case errors.Is(err, round.ErrNotFound): return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", admin.ErrNotFound, err); case errors.Is(err, round.ErrIllegalTransition), errors.Is(err, round.ErrActiveRound): return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", admin.ErrConflict, err) }; return err }

steps.action: Add type roundAdmin struct{Svc *round.Service} and implement the four admin.RoundService methods: Create calls Svc.Create(ctx, in.WorldID, in.StartsAt, in.Duration, in.BaseRelease); Open calls Svc.Open(ctx, worldID, roundID, round.OpenOptions{}) then Svc.Get; Close calls Svc.Close then Svc.Get; Get calls Svc.Get. Each returns toWorldRound(result) and mapRoundErr(err). Add var _ admin.RoundService = (*roundAdmin)(nil).
steps.expected: go build ./internal/server succeeds and the interface assertion holds

nodes.summary: Wire round.Service into server.New and start the scheduler in main
nodes.description: In server.New build round.FileStore, round.Service and admin.RoundHandler and mount five round routes under the admin group. Expose a NewScheduler builder and start it from main.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler runs in main with cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval
technical_constraints: Use existing gitCLI and contribution store

steps.action: Before r.Route("/api/v1/admin"...), build rs := &round.Service{Store:&round.FileStore{Root:cfg.Storage.RepoPath}, Committer:gitCLI, Revisions:gitCLI, Contributions:store} and rh := &admin.RoundHandler{Rounds:&roundAdmin{Svc:rs}, Lister:store}. Inside the admin group add ar.Post("/rounds", rh.Create), ar.Post("/rounds/{id}/open", rh.Open), ar.Post("/rounds/{id}/close", rh.Close), ar.Get("/rounds/{id}", rh.Get), ar.Get("/rounds/{id}/contributions", rh.Contributions). Import internal/round.
steps.expected: The five round routes no longer return 404

steps.action: Add func NewScheduler(cfg *config.Config) *round.Scheduler returning &round.Scheduler{Controller: the round.Service built from cfg, Rounds: the round.FileStore, Worlds: func() ([]string, error) listing IDs from world.Repo.List, Interval: cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval}. Extract the round.Service construction into helper newRoundService(cfg) used by both New and NewScheduler.
steps.expected: NewScheduler returns a scheduler with the configured interval

steps.action: Before http.ListenAndServe, create ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM); defer stop(); then go server.NewScheduler(cfg).Run(ctx).
